title: botrychium lunaria var. simplex
intro: Botrychium lunaria var. simplex, commonly known as Wood Fern, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the Ophioglossaceae family. It is a perennial plant found in various parts of the world, particularly in North America and Europe, and is valued for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits. The plant is said to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions, including reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Wood Fern include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
